reasoning_content: Missing SUPABASE_URL. Let me fix that in .env.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Add env vars
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("echo 'SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:8443' >> /opt/areloria/.env && echo 'SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=test' >> /opt/areloria/.env")
print("Added env")

# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria && sleep 5")
print("\nRestarted")

# Check
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list")
print("PM2:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
